svg.title: Smallest detectable difference by number of tasks
svg.text: How big a difference can you detect?
Smallest true difference found 80% of the time at p < 0.05, using the noise measured here
1 attempt per task: 419 tasks needed to detect 5 points
3 attempts per task: 140 tasks needed to detect 5 points
5 attempts per task: 84 tasks needed to detect 5 points
